yaru-xfwm4-theme on Omarchy

Ubuntu's Yaru look, brought to the Xfce window manager.

Package data synced 2026-10-24 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install yaru-xfwm4-theme on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add yaru-xfwm4-theme. It is a 94.5 KB download (116.5 KB installed), version 26.10.3-3, licensed GPL3. Yaru default ubuntu xfwm4 theme. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install yaru-xfwm4-theme on Omarchy

This package themes xfwm4, the window manager used by Xfce, with Yaru's window borders, title bars, and decorations so an Xfce session can visually match the rest of the Yaru desktop suite. It's for users pairing Xfce with Ubuntu's default theming rather than GNOME.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add yaru-xfwm4-theme
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 26.10.3-3:
    pacman -Qi yaru-xfwm4-theme

Open and use yaru-xfwm4-theme

yaru-xfwm4-theme has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql yaru-xfwm4-theme | grep /usr/bin/

yaru-xfwm4-theme requirements and compatibility

No special requirements are documented for yaru-xfwm4-theme.

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL3.

omarchy pkg drop yaru-xfwm4-theme

Frequently asked questions

How do I install yaru-xfwm4-theme on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add yaru-xfwm4-theme. The download is 94.5 KB and it takes 116.5 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is yaru-xfwm4-theme free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL3.

How do I uninstall yaru-xfwm4-theme?

Run omarchy pkg drop yaru-xfwm4-theme. It removes the package from your system.

What does yaru-xfwm4-theme depend on?

yaru-xfwm4-theme declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is yaru-xfwm4-theme a desktop app?

No. yaru-xfwm4-theme has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is yaru-xfwm4-theme in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as yaru-xfwm4-theme (version 26.10.3-3) in the official Omarchy package repository. Ubuntu makes it. Project site: https://github.com/ubuntu/yaru.
